rationale: DOX has gapped down ~31% on earnings results that were mixed (met EPS but missed revenue), creating an extremely wide spread (39 bps) and high uncertainty about where fair value settles. While relative volume is elevated at 17x and the stock is at 70% of today's range suggesting some stabilization, the post-gap price discovery phase is still early (only ~32 minutes into the session), the candle structure shows choppy, directionless action with no clear momentum, and the risk/reward is unclear given the magnitude of the move and ongoing price discovery. With an existing working long position in RIOT already committed, adding exposure to a post-earnings gap-down name with this level of uncertainty is not warranted.
